Also, argparse’s `nargs='+'` positional list greedily consumes later positional list values; I’m switching required lists to one-or-more positional nargs only if final, and using remainder collection for those cases to support multiple adjacent lists deterministically only where possible.

One inherent argparse constraint remains relevant: adjacent positional list parameters have no delimiter that tells argparse where one list ends and the next begins. The supported positional list case works cleanly when its values can be bounded by subsequent fixed positional arguments or it is the final positional; optional lists are explicitly delimited by the next flag. I’ll review the diff for implementation consistency now.
